training: none; user selected official published MetaWorld SFT checkpoint for frozen evaluation
benchmark: MT1 per task, 20 distinct reset configurations sampled without replacement from 50 train_tasks
action: official unnormalized 4D action; no residual controller or scripted expert
numerics: reference BF16 with selected FP32 parameters; inference only
execution: eager PyTorch via TORCH_COMPILE_DISABLE=1 to bound extra memory beside existing training
retry_policy: infrastructure errors are logged, do not count as task failures, and retry the same episode seed; max 2 restarts per worker
comparability: v2 task baseline with published SFT weights; not a reproduction of RLinf's MT50 v3 aggregate score
